name: marketing-intelligence-platform
description: Task runner de conveniencia. Ver docs/product/roadmap.md.

scripts.migrate: docker compose exec api alembic upgrade head
scripts.migrate:new: docker compose exec api alembic revision --autogenerate -m
scripts.seed: docker compose exec api python -m app.seed
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint:backend: docker compose exec api ruff check .
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.typecheck:backend: docker compose exec api mypy app
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:backend && npm run typecheck:frontend
scripts.security:backend: docker compose exec api sh -c "bandit -r app && pip-audit"
scripts.security: npm run security:backend && npm run security:frontend
